To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we propose a self-supervised learning method that maximizes predictive information, which is a measure of the amount of information about the future contained in past data; 2) we show that this method can learn useful representations of dynamical systems and speech; and 3) these representations can improve the performance of a speech recognition model.

(i) a simple estimate of predictive information is a good proxy of the mutual information lower-bound used by contrastive representation learning, (ii) the latent space of sequence data should have a simple structure, which can be encouraged by maximizing predictive information, and (iii) the predictive information maximization objective is complementary to the reconstruction objective, which is useful for learning representations for sequence data.

(1) we introduce a new representation learning method for sequential data, based on maximizing the predictive information in the latent feature sequences, and (2) this method can be used to pretrain a speech encoder for automatic speech recognition.
